procedure.method: Fresh independent critic session; no spawn, fork, resume, peer/producer/planner record inspection or image production/editing. Read the exact packet, literal case, rubric, rules, compact method/addendum and pinned adapter. Verified pins and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster viewing; did not follow their embedded unlisted source/call paths. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are both empty, so there were zero source-image opens and zero protected-layout reads to perform. Used functions.exec with tools.view_image(detail=original), forwarding each returned image_url to image(..., original), sequentially: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. All 15 exact images were actually displayed and visually inspected before starting intentional copy-reading/transcription, judgment or scoring. The native opens were 1672x941, use opens 720x405 and thumbnail opens 320x180. Hash/header verification was only binding evidence and was not treated as viewing. First readings were taken from the displayed native pixels, with the already displayed usage and thumbnail views used for readability/layout evaluation. No actual ambiguity required a revisit, and there were no additional poster opens. No tool event or runtime session identity is fabricated; session_id is null.
